title: AXI Burst, Lane, LAST, and 4 KB Checker
description: Execute FIXED/INCR/WRAP prediction, unaligned and narrow byte-lane masks, WSTRB legality, accepted LAST checks, and exact final-byte/split calculations.
learnerQuestion: Which derived address, active lane, accepted beat, or final byte first proves a burst is legal or illegal?

configurations.label: AXI4 64-bit
configurations.description: Eight byte lanes, INCR up to 256, FIXED 1–16, WRAP exactly 2/4/8/16.

configurations.label: AXI3 32-bit
configurations.description: Four byte lanes and 1–16 beats for burst types, with exact WRAP lengths.

scenarios.label: Legal four-beat WRAP
scenarios.description: AxADDR=0x10C, AxSIZE=2 and AxLEN=3 produce a 16-byte wrap region at 0x100–0x10F.

checks.label: Modulo wrap sequence
checks.evidence: The predictor uses N×2^AxSIZE and the wrap base, not bus width.

checks.label: One 4 KB region
checks.evidence: Every AXI burst type obeys the boundary rule.

scenarios.label: Unaligned narrow INCR lanes
scenarios.description: A four-byte INCR starting at 0x101 uses lanes 1–3 on its first transfer and lanes 4–7 at derived address 0x104.

checks.label: WSTRB inside first-beat mask
checks.evidence: Address low bits and WSTRB describe the same unaligned byte selection.

checks.label: Read uses no RSTRB
checks.evidence: Read scoring derives requested lanes from address and ARSIZE.

checks.label: Aligned subsequent progression
checks.evidence: After the unaligned first transfer, INCR advances from the aligned base by 2^AxSIZE.

scenarios.label: Illegal LAST and WSTRB
scenarios.description: Accepted beat count, not elapsed cycles, catches early LAST; WSTRB outside the derived lane mask is independently illegal.

steps.label: Accept bad beat
steps.event: Beat 3 of 4 has WLAST=1 and WSTRB=0x81 for legal mask 0x0F

checks.label: LAST iff final accepted beat
checks.evidence: Early termination is unsupported; recovery remains implementation-defined.

checks.label: WSTRB subset of active lanes
checks.evidence: The checker reports the lane-mask error separately from LAST.

scenarios.label: Exact 4 KB split
scenarios.description: A four-beat, four-byte INCR at 0xFF8 ends at byte 0x1007; the manager must issue two legal requests.

steps.label: Detect crossing
steps.event: Accept geometry candidate before issuing AW

checks.label: First/final byte region
checks.evidence: The unsplit candidate crosses from the 0x0000 decode region into 0x1000.

steps.label: Split request
steps.event: Issue 2 beats at 0xFF8 and 2 beats at 0x1000

checks.label: Each split stays in one region
checks.evidence: Decode/routing sees one destination per accepted burst.

checks.label: Two transactions generated
checks.evidence: The manager-side splitter preserves the requested byte range without issuing an illegal burst.

traceability.coverage: burst × length × size × offset × lane mask

traceability.stimulus: accepted-beat stalls, early/missing LAST, edge-of-region splits
